decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 11.2	The application for a first floor side extension to the existing dwelling, as shown on drawing numbers H160/P/1, H160/P2, & H160/P/3, received 3 October 2005, is recommended for approval as by reason of its size, position and appearance, the extension would be compatible with the style and form of the original building, and it would satisfactorily maintain the amenity of adjoining neighbours and the character and appearance of the Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of first floor side extension over existing double side garage to create a bedroom to house. (Chiswick House Conservation Area)
